text:
maria_support: FYI customer reported promo GRANT-APR24 landed on their Private deployment credits instead of the Dedicated pool. They spun up dedicated nodes yesterday and expected credits to apply there.
ashok_billing: Can you paste the tenant and promo code? I can look in the ledger.
maria_support: tenant: redwood-acme-577, promo: GRANT-APR24. Customer says UI shows "Applied to Private" and dedicated invoice still shows full charge. They need it moved OR a refund.
luis_eng: Do you have the billing transaction id or API event? If it was applied at billing-level vs allocation-level this is something automate can fix.
maria_support: Here's the billing entry from their org view (redacted):

```
txn_id: txn_8b9f3a
applied_to: PRIVATE_CREDITS
amount: 5000
meta: {deployment: "private-nyc-1", invoice_id: inv_9987}
```

They expected APPLIED_TO to be DEDICATED_POOL.
ashok_billing: Hmm looks like our promo-routing lambda picked Private because their default endpoint in org settings is private. We usually route based on preferred_deployment. If they had a dedicated subscription but didn't set it as default this can happen.
clare_cs: Customer claims they followed the flow on the console and selected "Apply to Dedicated" during checkout. They have screenshot but it's partial.
maria_support: Screenshot attached in thread (not included here). They need solution before EOD. Escalating.
ashok_billing: Short-term: I can make an accounting adjustment to reassign the 5000 credit to their dedicated pool and generate a corrected invoice. That requires engineering to update allocation records so we don't double-count.
luis_eng: I can run a one-off migration script to move the allocation from PRIVATE_CREDITS -> DEDICATED_POOL for tenant redwood-acme-577. Need a time window (few minutes) and a rollback plan. Also want to capture why default routing chose private.
sam_sre: If we change the allocation now, any live requests using that Private deployment may see their available credits drop. Is that ok? Customer said they aren't using Private for prod.
maria_support: Customer confirmed Private nodes were just for evaluation and are idle. They're okay with us moving it.
luis_eng: Plan:
1) snapshot current allocation (db backup) 2) run migration: update allocations set pool='DEDICATED' where txn_id='txn_8b9f3a' 3) run billing reconciliation job 4) reissue invoice
I will run steps during low-traffic window now.
ashok_billing: Please also update the promo-routing rule to prefer dedicated when customer's subscription has an active dedicated commitment to avoid recurrence.
luis_eng: Noted. I'll investigate config mismatch. Quick grep shows their org prefs had "preferred_deployment": "private" even though they have dedicated commit. We'll add validation in the promo service.
billing-bot: [automated] Created task BILL-4572 to reassign promo credits and regenerate invoice. Owner: ashok_billing. ETA: 2 hours.
clare_cs: I've messaged the customer letting them know we're working and we'll confirm when credits are moved. Thanks team.
maria_support: Thanks everyone. @luis_eng please ping here when done so I can confirm with customer.
luis_eng: Migration complete. Allocation shows DEDICATED_POOL, invoice inv_9987 corrected to apply -$50. Confirmed via staging queries.
maria_support: I confirmed with customer; they see credits on their dedicated dashboard and the invoice looks correct. Closing the loop. :thumbsup:
ashok_billing: Follow-ups: (1) patch promo-service to consider dedicated commitments, (2) add a UI warning when applying to non-default pool, (3) retro check for similar misapplies in last 30 days.
sam_sre: I'll add a monitoring alert for sudden allocation moves too.
clare_cs: Noted — will update the support ticket and send the customer a post-mortem blurb.
maria_support: Great, thanks team.
